summary: RX Tech iteration_5 — Focused retest of 'Switch to Distributor' entry point on pharmacist /(tabs)/more.tsx. PASS on all 3 review-request scenarios. Login via demo@rxtech.com + dev OTP from URL banner works. The More tab now renders a prominent 'Switch to Distributor mode' banner (testID='switch-distributor') above the Operations section, with an icon + label + sub-label and chevron. Tapping it triggers the cross-platform confirm() → on web this surfaces as a native window.confirm with title 'Switch to Distributor mode?'. Accepting POSTs /api/distributor/switch-role {role:'distributor'} and router.replace('/d/home') lands the user on the distributor dashboard (verified URL = /d/home). On /d/home the 6-tab bottom bar renders Home/Orders/Stock/Customers/Money/More; the 3 quick tiles (Collections/Customers/Messages) render; the Messages quick tile shows the unread badge=2 and the hero chat icon also shows 2; KPIs show Pending 5, Dispatched 1, Delivered today 0, TODAY'S SALES ₹8,860, OUTSTANDING ₹1,15,700; top-customers list and last-7-days bar chart render. Round-trip: tapping the distributor More tab shows 'Switch to Pharmacist mode' banner (testID='switch-pharmacist'), confirm → POST switch-role {role:'pharmacist'} → router.replace('/home'). Final URL = /home (pharmacist). No console errors during the flow; only the same pre-existing warnings ('props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and 'No route named order/[id]') remain.

issues: The 'Switch to Distributor mode' banner is positioned just below the profile card and renders correctly on mobile 390x844 — clear visual hierarchy. No design issues observed.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' still emitted on every navigation. Same as iterations 1-4.
Pre-existing: 'No route named "order/[id]" exists in nested children' Expo Router warning still emitted; cosmetic but should be cleaned up.

action_items: (carry-over LOW) Resolve 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' warning in shared component (likely TopBar/SafeAreaView wrapper or Modal).
(carry-over LOW) Remove orphan 'order/[id]' route reference from (tabs)/_layout register to silence Expo Router warning.

(carry-over MED from iter_4) Add testID props to remaining interactive elements on /d/home, /d/customers, /d/collections, /d/customer/[id], /d/messages/* (Record Payment, Edit limit, Credit Note, Debit Note, Collect, chat input, filter chips, customer rows) for robust automated testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is clean: switchToDistributor() in (tabs)/more.tsx mirrors switchToPharmacist() in /d/more.tsx exactly — same confirm() utility, same /distributor/switch-role POST, same router.replace pattern.
Banner uses dedicated styles (banner, bannerIcon, bannerTitle, bannerSub) with primaryBg/primarySoft tokens — good visual prominence without using a list row.

testID='switch-distributor' is correctly exposed; matches naming convention. (Note: review request mentioned 'more-switch-distributor' in iter_4 action item, but the actual testID is 'switch-distributor' — symmetric with 'switch-pharmacist' on the distributor side; this is acceptable and verified working.)
On web, confirm() uses window.confirm — flow validated via Playwright dialog handler (auto-accept). On native, it will use Alert.alert. No code change needed.
router.replace('/d/home') (not push) — correct, avoids back-stack pollution between the two modes.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only retest, backend already 100% in iter_4)
success_rate.frontend: 3/3 scenarios PASS — switch entry visible, navigation to /d/home with 6 tabs + quick tiles + unread badge, round-trip back to /home

seed_data_creation: None for this iteration. Used existing seed (demo@rxtech.com → dist-1 / ABC Pharma).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The pharmacist↔distributor mode switch is now fully wired end-to-end. Confirm dialogs on web surface as window.confirm — any future Playwright tests must register a `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())` handler before tapping switch buttons, otherwise the confirm() call appears to do nothing. OTP boxes on /auth/otp are 6 separate <input> elements; the working pattern is: click coordinates (60,280) to focus the first box, then page.keyboard.type(otp) — auto-advances through boxes. Dev OTP is exposed in the URL query string as ?devOtp=XXXXXX on /auth/otp.
rca_of_issue: Fix verified: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/more.tsx now contains (lines 50-69) switchToDistributor() and (lines 134-143) a TouchableOpacity banner with testID='switch-distributor' that calls it. Banner sits between the profile card and the 'Operations' section. Pressing it → confirm dialog → on confirm, POST /api/distributor/switch-role with body {role:'distributor'} and router.replace('/d/home'). Verified live: from /more → tap banner → window.confirm 'Switch to Distributor mode?' → accept → URL becomes /d/home with distributor 6-tab UI, 3 quick tiles, unread badges, and seeded ABC Pharma data. Round-trip from /d/more → 'Switch to Pharmacist mode' → /home. Closes the HIGH-priority UX gap from iteration_4.
